title: OmegaHyper: Explicit-State HyperLTL Model Checking on an omega-Automaton Diet
abstract: arXiv:2611.24210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: HyperLTL extends LTL with quantification over traces. AUtoHyper is the de facto explicit-state model checker for HyperLTL, complete for an arbitrary quantifier prefix: it eliminates quantifiers through products of the formula's omega-automaton with the systems, complementing on quantifier alternations. However, it suffers from state explosion, as it fully materializes input systems and intermediate automata. We present OmegaHyper, an overhaul of AutoHyper that keeps its algorithm but decomposes and reduces the size of the processed automata, and integrates the Kofola omega-automaton complementation tool. We compare OmegaHyper with existing explicit-state and symbolic HyperLTL model checkers, on 120 benchmarks from their published suites. OmegaHyper improves the performance of explicit-state HyperLTL model checking by up to orders of magnitude; bounded symbolic tools still reach further on violated instances with short counterexamples, as

translated_title: OmegaHyper：基于ω-自动机“瘦身”的显式状态HyperLTL模型检测
translated_abstract: HyperLTL通过对轨迹的量化扩展了LTL。AUtoHyper是事实上的HyperLTL显式状态模型检测器，对任意量词前缀均完备：它通过将公式的ω-自动机与系统做乘积来消除量词，并在量词交替处进行求补。然而，由于它需要完整地实体化输入系统和中间自动机，因此面临状态爆炸问题。我们提出了OmegaHyper，它是对AutoHyper的一次全面改造，保留了原有算法，但分解并缩减了所处理自动机的规模，同时集成了Kofola ω-自动机求补工具。我们在来自已发布测试集的120个基准测试上，将OmegaHyper与现有的显式状态及符号化HyperLTL模型检测器进行了比较。结果表明，OmegaHyper将显式状态HyperLTL模型检测的性能提升了多达几个数量级；而对于具有短反例的违规实例，有界的符号化工具仍然能够覆盖更多……
tldr: OmegaHyper在保留AutoHyper算法的基础上，通过分解与缩减所处理的ω-自动机并集成Kofola求补工具，将显式状态HyperLTL模型检测的性能提升了多达几个数量级。
en_tdlr: OmegaHyper overhauls the explicit-state HyperLTL model checker AutoHyper by decomposing and shrinking the processed omega-automata and integrating the Kofola complementation tool, improving performance by up to orders of magnitude.
